source_evidence.claim: Full source includes count argument, CSR initialization and timed complete row kernel.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock-bounded call into count-taking kernel; complete worker covers requested repetitions, assigned rows and CSR nonzeros with arithmetic and stores.
